audit.why: 53.62% over 2251 games with Diana on all seven chart rows; her range beats a melee-only kit that has to stack Ionian Fervor before it threatens anything.
audit.corrected: Diana-favoured; the 7/10 difficulty is the Flawless Duet stun, not the lane balance.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer chart gave Irelia the first four rows and read 'Skill' on the last three, while win[0..6] and packet.levelChart are Diana on all seven.
audit.why: Every row disagreed across layers; the phases whys already describe Diana winning.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.mid calls her escape an 'E-dash-through-minion' — Flawless Duet (E) is the stun; the dash is Bladesurge (Q), which refreshes on a Marked target or a kill. breakdown.cooldowns carried no cooldown number and two bullets were the trade lines pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: Riot text: Bladesurge (Q) 10/9/8/7/6, dash that heals and refreshes on a Marked target; Defiant Dance (W) 20/18/16/14/12 with physical damage reduction while charging; Flawless Duet (E) 16/14.5/13/11.5/10, two blades converging to stun and Mark; Vanguard's Edge (R) 125/105/85 leaves a wall.
audit.corrected: Dash named as Bladesurge, the Mark-refresh loop stated, and real cooldowns written into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal and the itemization row said only 'anti-heal early into his sustain' — no item named, wrong pronoun.
audit.why: Bladesurge heals her on every cast and refreshes off Marked targets, so extended trades hinge on Grievous Wounds.
audit.corrected: Itemization now names Oblivion Orb and says why.

edits.before: - Irelia Flawless Duet (Stun): matchup-defining — Her stun setup — dodge it and the dive falls apart. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Pale Cascade like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
